stats.notes: IPEDS ADM2023 (fall 2023 first-time students): 1,221 applicants, 981 admitted, 530 enrolled. College Navigator fall 2024: 1,315 applicants, 76% admitted (counts of admits not shown). IPEDS reports no international applicant or admit counts for Southeastern, so those are null; nonresidents are about 2% of undergraduates (fall 2024, rounded). Undergraduate enrollment 3,224 and the 25:1 ratio are fall 2024. No Common Data Set for recent years was found on the web (only a 2011-12 copy on a third-party host), so this is the IPEDS baseline; GPA, residency and class-rank details are not included.

cost.notes: College Navigator 2024-25: tuition and fees in-state $7,530, out-of-state $16,740; on-campus food and housing $7,760, other $3,216; total_coa_usd is the out-of-state on-campus total.
